reason: I'd probably start the free 14-day trial since there's no auto-billing, but I'm already cutting subscriptions every month and I fall asleep to free YouTube sounds on my AirPods. Another 4,900 won a month for a smarter fade-out and a lock-screen button doesn't feel necessary to me right now.
objection: With AirPods the fancy auto-resume is off anyway, so it's basically a sleep timer that fades out. I doubt the difference is more than a few minutes, and on iPhone getting a refund through Apple sounds like a hassle I'd just give up on.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day comparison actually showed me falling asleep clearly faster, like 10+ minutes, on the SLEEP:ON nights, I'd pay the yearly 39,000 won.
